# @zakkster/lite-snow

> Zero-GC SoA environmental snow engine. Drift physics, living-air forces (gust, turbulence, drag), persistent-pack accumulation, friction, Z-depth parallax, bucketed rendering, 4 complete presets, reduced-motion + spawn shaping. Zero dependencies.

## Install
npm i @zakkster/lite-snow

## Dependencies
None. Zero runtime deps: OKLCH object -> CSS string is inlined in the engine.

## Import
import { SnowEngine, SNOW_PRESETS } from '@zakkster/lite-snow';

## Key Facts
- 14 SoA arrays: x, y, z, gz, wz, bucket, radius, driftPhase, driftSpeed, driftAmp, life, state, vx, vy
- Precomputed per-flake: gz[]=gravity*z, wz[]=wind*z, radius[]=base*z, driftAmp[]=amp*z, bucket[]
- Living air (S5): gust (global sinusoidal horizontal accel, phase on the _elapsedTime clock), turbulence (per-flake rotating accel reusing driftPhase/driftSpeed, zero new rng), drag (terminal-velocity damping). All OFF by default; default output is byte-identical to v1.1.1. vx[]/vy[] carry the perturbation; drag !== 1 is a separate integration model (decisions/0002)
- Two-phase lifecycle: flake(state=1) drifts down -> settles (state=2) -> melts as a flat ellipse; when accumulate:true it also raises a persistent pack column at the settle transition
- Accumulation (S6, opt-in): accumulate:true builds a persistent Uint16 heightmap (pack) that flakes land ON and that decays over time. Off by default; when off pack===null and output is byte-identical to v1.2.0. Construction-time only: a runtime flip of config.accumulate is inert. An EXACT integer ledger: packSum === landed - decayed - capped - truncated. Out-of-range columns (overhang/wind) settle at floorY and raise nothing (skip, never clamp). maxPackHeight caps a column; over-width degrades visibly (no realloc); resize TRUNCATES the pack (drift lost, booked exactly). floorY (default null=track h) sets the settle floor; friction (default 0) damps vx once on the contact frame
- Sinusoidal drift: per-flake random phase + speed + depth-scaled amplitude
- Z-depth parallax (0.2-1.0): all physics/render params scale by depth
- Bin-driven render: the physics pass bins every live flake into 4 preallocated Uint32 index lists (3 depth buckets + melt) in one sweep; render iterates only live slots. One full-pool scan per frame, down from 5
- 3 depth-bucket fills + (1 pack fill when accumulate:true and the pack is non-empty) + one fill per populated melt band = 3 + [0..1] + up to 8 draw calls per frame, independent of on-screen flake count
- Melt phase: ellipse (2.5× wider, 0.5× tall) with life-ratio alpha fade
- Dimension cache: _areaModifier recomputed only on canvas size change
- Off-screen culling: X +/- 200px and Y < -200 (wind + negative gravity leak)
- Responsive density: spawn count scales with canvas area
- 4 presets: SNOW_PRESETS.flurry, .heavy, .blizzard, .calm -- each a COMPLETE 21-key scene (every scene knob named, defaults included via the same constants), so { ...calm, ...heavy } equals heavy exactly. Presets do NOT name rng, color or reducedMotion (injection/appearance/accessibility, not scene). flurry's values ARE the engine defaults, so its digest equals the no-preset default
- reducedMotion (S7): a HARD OVERRIDE. reducedMotion:true overwrites the twelve MOTION keys (gravity, wind, density, baseRadius, driftAmplitude, driftFreq, gust, gustFreq, turbulence, drag, spawnBand, spawnMargin) with calm's values -- the flag WINS over any explicit knob set alongside it ({ ...blizzard, reducedMotion:true } equals calm; { reducedMotion:true, gust:500 } has gust 0). Strict === true arms it; resolved ONCE at construction, absent from both frame loops, so a runtime flip is inert. Non-MOTION keys (accumulate, pack*, floorY, friction, meltTime*) are NOT overridden -- accumulation is a pile, not motion
- spawnBand (S7, default null): { min, max } shapes the spawn Y band as the SUBTRACTIVE draw y = max - rng()*(max-min); the mirror min + rng()*(max-min) is a different per-draw value and is NOT used. null/garbage/non-finite bound/max<min fails closed to the literal -50/-100 default band (byte-identical to v1.3.0). spawnMargin (S7, default null): a fixed spawn inset in px; null = DERIVE the v1.3.0 wind-offset (h/gravity)*|wind|. Both COERCE (they size no allocation), unlike packResolution/maxPackWidth/maxPackHeight which THROW (they size the Uint16 pack)
- meltingCount is the LANDED count: state 2 IS the SETTLED state -- a flake that has landed (on the floor, or on the pack when accumulate:true) and is now aging out. There is no separate landedCount getter (decisions/0003 (b), 0004 (a))
- No clearRect -- snow is overlay. Caller clears.
- spawn() and updateAndDraw() separate -- caller controls timing
- Pre-parsed OKLCH color in constructor
- RNG injectable, no lite-random dep
- Ring-cursor spawn (SN-12): persistent _spawnCursor wraps; a full wrap with no free slot fails closed (stops, never spins); clear() resets it
- Melt alpha quantized into <= 8 bands so N melters batch into <= 8 fills (SN-06); melt y clamped to h on resize-shrink (SN-08)
- destroy() nulls the 14 SoA arrays, the 4 render-bin lists and the accumulation pack (when armed) AND releases config, colorStr; runs clear() first
- Fail-closed door: non-finite or negative dt, or w/h <= 0, is a no-op frame (no clock advance, no state touch)
- 66 bytes/particle: 50 SoA (12 Float32 x,y,z,gz,wz,radius,driftPhase,driftSpeed,driftAmp,life,vx,vy + 2 Uint8 bucket,state) + 16 for 4 Uint32 render-bin lists, allocated once, rebuilt in place each frame. vx/vy add +8 B/particle over v1.1.1 (+80 KB at max 10000)
- Accumulation pack is a SEPARATE fixed cost, NOT per-particle: one Uint16Array(maxPackWidth/packResolution) columns, allocated once and only when accumulate:true (default 4096/4 = 1024 cols = 2 KB), never reallocated. Unarmed: pack===null, zero cost
- maxParticles ceiling MAX_PARTICLES = 10000000; a non-integer or out-of-range max throws RangeError before allocation
- baseRadius must be a finite number > 0 or the constructor throws RangeError; radius[] clamped to MIN_RADIUS (0.01)
- clear() is a full reset: pool, clock, dimension cache and telemetry counters
- updateAndDraw ctx door: a null ctx or one missing arc()/ellipse() is a no-op frame
- A draw call that throws mid-render restores globalAlpha to 1.0 and RETHROWS
- SNOW_PRESETS and each of .flurry/.heavy/.blizzard/.calm are Object.frozen; no preset holds a nested object (spawnBand is the null sentinel), so Object.isFrozen is true all the way down

## API
- VERSION: '1.4.0'
- new SnowEngine(maxParticles?, config?)
- .spawn(dt, w, h) -- spawn new flakes
- .updateAndDraw(ctx, dt, w, h) -- physics + render
- .clear() -- kill all
- .destroy() -- release arrays
- .fallingCount / .meltingCount / .activeCount -- live telemetry getters (O(1))

## Config
gravity (40), wind (30), density (10), baseRadius (2.5), driftAmplitude (15),
driftFreq (1.0), meltTimeMin (2.0), meltTimeMax (5.0),
gust (0), gustFreq (TAU/3), turbulence (0), drag (1 = off),
accumulate (false), packResolution (4), maxPackWidth (4096), maxPackHeight (200),
packDecay (2.0 units/s), floorY (null = track h), friction (0),
spawnBand (null), spawnMargin (null), reducedMotion (false),
color ('oklch(0.98 0.02 250)'), rng (Math.random)
Each living-air knob fails closed: a non-finite value (incl. null) lands on its default, not on 0.
gustFreq 0 with gust armed is a stated no-op: sin(0)*gust freezes the gust off (0 Hz = no oscillation).
accumulate is construction-time only (strict === true arms it); a runtime flip is inert. When armed, packResolution [1..256], maxPackWidth [packResolution..16384] and maxPackHeight [1..65535] must be integers or the constructor throws RangeError naming the value. floorY: non-finite -> null. friction: clamped [0,1], negative -> 0. packDecay: non-finite -> default 2.0, negative -> 0.
spawnBand: { min, max } both finite and max >= min shapes the spawn band (subtractive form); null (default), non-object, non-finite bound or max < min fails closed to the -50/-100 default band. spawnMargin: finite >= 0 used raw as the spawn inset; non-finite or negative -> null = derive. reducedMotion: strict === true is a hard override resolved once at construction (the flag wins, motion keys become calm's); it resolves BEFORE baseRadius validation, so { baseRadius: 0, reducedMotion: true } constructs (baseRadius becomes calm's 2.5) while { baseRadius: 0 } throws.

## Presets
SNOW_PRESETS.flurry -- gentle (its values ARE the engine defaults)
SNOW_PRESETS.heavy -- dense, windy
SNOW_PRESETS.blizzard -- extreme wind + density
SNOW_PRESETS.calm -- minimal motion (density 4, wind 8, gravity 20, driftAmplitude 4); the reducedMotion target
Each preset is COMPLETE (all 21 scene keys). Excluded: rng, color, reducedMotion.

## Game Loop
snow.spawn(dt, w, h);
ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);       // caller clears
drawScene();                       // caller scene
snow.updateAndDraw(ctx, dt, w, h); // snow overlays

## Reduced Motion (app-layer wiring)
The engine does NO DOM access -- read the media query in your app and pass the flag:
const reduce = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
const snow = new SnowEngine(2000, { ...SNOW_PRESETS.blizzard, reducedMotion: reduce });
// reducedMotion:true forces the calm scene (hard override); false leaves the preset intact.
